verdict.rationale: Docs mention describing workflows in natural language to create agents (monday-docs-13/14) and various no-code integration paths, suggesting some no-code automation capability, but the evidence pack focuses mainly on AI-agent/MCP tooling rather than monday's classic drag-and-drop multi-step automation recipes, leaving the core story under-evidenced. Community feedback also raises concerns about usability and reliability that could undercut ease-of-use claims.
